connector.name: Funplay Unreal MCP
connector.registryDescription: stdio bridge for the local Unreal Editor MCP server from FunplayAI/funplay-unreal-mcp.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package funplay-unreal-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the funplayai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FUNPLAY_UNREAL_MCP_URL
env.description: Optional Unreal MCP HTTP endpoint. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8765/.

env.name: UNREAL_MCP_URL
env.description: Compatibility endpoint variable used when FUNPLAY_UNREAL_MCP_URL is not set.

env.name: FUNPLAY_UNREAL_MCP_TOKEN
env.description: Unreal MCP local auth token from the Funplay MCP editor menu or Saved/FunplayMCP/funplay_mcp_settings.json.

env.name: UNREAL_MCP_TOKEN
env.description: Compatibility token variable used when FUNPLAY_UNREAL_MCP_TOKEN is not set.
